# GaitModels

Kind: context · Defined in [`src/logic/animals/gait.h`](../../../src/logic/animals/gait.h) · Described in `data/animals.json`

Gait models (analyseGait) of the species' clips, analysed on first use.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `models` | `std::unordered_map<const AnimalSpecies*, std::unordered_map<int, GaitModel>>` | Per species and clip index: legs, period, speed, ground, hips, anchors, valid / problem. |

## Notes

Emplaced by AnimalGait in preinit; get() analyses and logs on first use. Keyed by species pointer: valid while the library keeps the species.
